strategies.name: Mean Reversion (Z-Score)
strategies.description: Enter long when the N-day return z-score drops below entry_z; exit when it recovers above exit_z. Fixed share size.

entry_z.description: Enter long when z drops below this (typically negative).

exit_z.description: Exit when z rises above this.

strategies.name: Trend Following (Golden Cross)
strategies.description: Buy when short SMA crosses above long SMA and the close is above the 200-day MA; sell on the opposite cross.

strategies.name: Regime-Aware Momentum
strategies.description: Buy on a simple positive-momentum signal; size the position from the 20-day realised volatility (small in high-vol, large in low-vol). Demonstrates regime adaptation.

vol_threshold.description: Daily-return stdev above which the regime is 'high vol'.

strategies.name: Custom Strategy (DSL)
strategies.description: Your own entry/exit rules over indicator comparisons — e.g. enter when sma(20) > sma(50), exit when rsi(14) > 70. Parsed and evaluated server-side with a restricted expression grammar.

entry.description: Entry rule. Fields: open, high, low, close, volume. Functions: sma(n), ema(n), rsi(n), highest(n), lowest(n), stdev(n), change(n). Operators: + - * /, comparisons, and/or/not.

exit.description: Exit rule — same grammar as entry.
